issues.note: Owner asked for this paper recorded without a full syllabus extraction, given time pressure. The syllabus file here lists all 11 real AS/A Level chapter titles (taken from the syllabus's own subject-content headings) but only one placeholder section/outcome per chapter, not every numbered sub-point (e.g. 7.5.1-7.5.10). Question topic refs point at these placeholder chapter-level outcomes rather than genuine syllabus sub-points.

This paper is pure multiple choice (30 one-mark items, no structured/essay parts). The published MS is only the correct letter with no working to transcribe, so each question's markScheme is just {marks:1, correctOption, points:[one point stating the answer]} and all the substantive analysis — why each option is right or wrong — lives in aiSupplement.optionAnalysis, a new field added specifically for MCQ. This matches the owner's original motivation for Cipher: MCQ mark schemes never explain the distractors.

Several questions (3, 6, 11, 13, 19, 24, 29) have a diagram in the stem, cropped from the QP page image rather than redrawn as vector, matching the figure convention used for other subjects. Several others (7, 12, 16, 22) present their four options as a comparison table rather than plain A/B/C/D text; these use the existing "table" stem type with the option letter as the first column.
